questions.question: When pulling a trailer, the air supply control lever should be in what position?
questions.explanation: The air supply control should be set to the "normal" position when pulling a trailer. Some older vehicles have levers instead of knobs to control this.

questions.question: Why are roads especially slippery when rain first begins to fall?

options.text: The water mixes with oil and grease on the road.
Tires are not made to drive in wet weather.
The water has not yet absorbed the dirt and grease.

questions.correctAnswerText: The water mixes with oil and grease on the road.
questions.explanation: When rain first falls, it mixes with oil and grease on the road surface. This creates a slick film before the water washes away the buildup.

questions.question: Where can you leave a vehicle carrying explosives unattended?

options.text: On the shoulder of a highway.

questions.explanation: You may only leave a vehicle with explosives unattended in a safe haven. A safe haven is an approved location for parking vehicles loaded with explosives.

questions.question: What happens if you stay in neutral too long while changing gears?

options.text: You may have trouble putting the vehicle into the next gear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may have trouble putting the vehicle into the next gear.
questions.explanation: Staying in neutral too long makes it hard to shift into the next gear. Do not force the gear shift. Instead, go back to neutral, release the clutch, match the engine speed to the road speed, and try again.

questions.question: What license does a driver need to transport hazardous materials?

options.text: A CDL with a hazardous materials endorsement
A CDL with a tank endorsement
A CDL with a cargo endorsement

questions.correctAnswerText: A CDL with a hazardous materials endorsement
questions.explanation: You must have a CDL with a hazardous materials endorsement to drive any vehicle carrying hazardous materials.

questions.question: What is not allowed for regrooved tires?

options.text: Should not be used on any vehicle.
Should not be used on the front of a bus.
Should not be used on trucks hauling gravel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should not be used on the front of a bus.
questions.explanation: Regrooved, recapped, or retreaded tires cannot be used on the front wheels of a bus.

questions.question: How should the tractor be positioned when backing up to couple a trailer?

options.text: Directly in front of the trailer.

questions.correctAnswerText: Directly in front of the trailer.
questions.explanation: Position the tractor directly in front of the trailer when backing up to couple. Backing at an angle could move the trailer and damage the landing gear.

questions.question: What is correct about a safety belt?
questions.explanation: A safety belt should be securely mounted, adjustable, and latch properly. It should not be ripped or frayed.

questions.question: What should you do with cargo inside a trailer?

options.text: It does not need to be secured.
Stack it no more than three feet high.

questions.explanation: Cargo must be properly secured to keep it from shifting during transport.

questions.question: What does gravity do on an uphill grade?
questions.explanation: Gravity slows your vehicle down on any uphill grade. You may need to shift to a lower gear to climb a steep hill.

questions.question: On a curve, is the posted speed limit safe for all vehicles?

options.text: Yes, any vehicle can safely drive at this speed.
No, a vehicle could still tip over at this speed.
It is the minimum legal speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: No, a vehicle could still tip over at this speed.
questions.explanation: The posted speed limit on a curve may be safe for cars, but it can be too fast for larger vehicles like trucks. A truck driver going at the posted speed limit on a curve could cause their vehicle to tip over.

questions.question: How can you avoid distracted driving?

options.text: By avoiding complex conversations with passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: By avoiding complex conversations with passengers.
questions.explanation: Distractions while driving can be physical, mental, or both. Ways to avoid distracted driving include: pre-program your radio; plan your route ahead of time; avoid difficult conversations while driving; adjust mirrors before leaving; and do not eat, drink, or smoke while driving.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver confronts you, what should you do?
questions.explanation: When facing an aggressive driver, get out of their way if possible. Do not make eye contact, as this may make them angrier. Ignore any hand gestures they make.

questions.question: When backing a trailer, which way should you turn the steering wheel?

options.text: In the direction you want the trailer to move.
In the opposite direction from where you want the trailer to move.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the opposite direction from where you want the trailer to move.
questions.explanation: When backing with a trailer, turn the steering wheel opposite to where you want the trailer to go. Once the trailer starts turning, turn the steering wheel the other way to follow it.

questions.question: The National Response Center must be told about an incident with any of these, except:
questions.explanation: The National Response Center must be notified of incidents with: death; hospitalization; $50,000 or more in property damage; evacuation of the public or closure of a major transportation route for more than one hour; or fire, spillage, or contamination involving radiation, bacteria, or toxins. The carrier should also report if they believe the situation is serious enough.

questions.question: When backing with a trailer, why should you turn toward the driver's side?

options.text: Because turning toward the passenger side is illegal.
Because other drivers can help you.

questions.explanation: Back toward the driver's side when possible. This gives you the best view of your path.

questions.question: What is the best advice for driving in fog?

options.text: Avoid driving in fog if possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid driving in fog if possible.
questions.explanation: Driving in fog is dangerous. Avoid it if you can. If you must drive in fog, use your low beam headlights and fog lights, even during the day.

questions.question: What does the emergency air line supply?
questions.explanation: The emergency air line (also called the supply line) has two jobs: it supplies air to the trailer air tanks and it controls the emergency brakes on combination vehicles.

questions.question: What tread depth must front tires have in every major groove?
questions.explanation: Commercial vehicles must have 4/32 inch tread depth in every major groove on front tires. Other tires must have at least 2/32 inch tread depth.

questions.question: Who is responsible for properly labeling hazardous materials?
questions.explanation: The shipper must package, mark, and label hazardous materials correctly. It is good practice for the driver to check that materials are labeled properly.
